adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` creates `embeddable_hosts` with only columns (no index on `host` or `lower(host)`). The hot-path lookup in `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` uses `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first`, which cannot use a plain index even if one existed; with no index at all it will require a sequential scan as the table grows. This is a concrete performance/scalability issue introduced by the new table and query, not a functional correctness bug.
